lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Two hundred and ninety megawatts. Be advised there is warden activity on the deck already.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Nine. They are formed up on the ingress lane facing away from the ring.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Can we put a relay over them? So they can see.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over capacity. Shed the far lane — nothing of ours is standing in it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor is held. Meridian losses: none.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Log nine wardens destroyed in place, facing outward.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: That is not a category Actual maintains.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.beat: nobody says the word ally, at any point, and that is the level
